trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Problem:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back to v2.3.0 — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all regions. Verified the service is now healthy with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback, and it paged the on-call engineer.

Note: only v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production, so no change-manager approval was needed for the rollback to the previously healthy v2.3.0.
